description: Copy an app's store listing pictures — its phone screenshots and its icon — from the App Store or Google Play into the media library, returning media ids: the screenshots become shots for create_video (app_showcase especially) and the icon its brand mark (iconMediaId). Reads the listing the workspace's brand profile holds when no url is given. Costs no credits; a picture already imported is reused rather than copied again. Apple's listing is read through its lookup API; Google Play's from its page, best effort.

store.description: Which of the profile's listings to read (default: the App Store one when both are saved)

url.description: The App Store or Google Play link; omit to use the brand profile's

workspaceId.description: Which workspace to act in — an id from list_workspaces. Optional with a single workspace; REQUIRED once there are several, where guessing would mean posting one client's content to another client's accounts. Ask the user which one before publishing.

name: import_app_screenshots
title: Import app store screenshots
